chapter.verse: Topa aw, ka thungetna hong za in la, ka hong thuumna hong ngai in.
Ka cihmawh hunin kei kiang panin bu kei in! Keima lam hong nga in la, kong sap ciangin hong dawng pah in!
Bang hang hiam cih leh keima nuntakna, meikhu bangin beimang a, ka pumpi, meikuang bangin a sa hi.
Lungkham lua-in lopa bangin ka keutum a, an nangawn ka ne zo kei hi.
A ging-in ka tautauna hangin ka guh guakin ka om hi.
Gamlak-a om musane leh mun kolhna-a om simbu tawh ka kibang hi;
ihmu thei loin ka om a, innkhum dawn-a vasa khatguak om tawh ka kibang hi.
Sun nilohin ka galte in kei hong zahko a, kei hong simmawhte in ciamsiatna-in ka min zang uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka annek in vutte hi a, nangma thangpaihna leh hehna hangin ka tui dawnte khitui tawh kihel hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang hehna in kei hong domto napi-in nong khiasuk kik hi.
Keima nuntakna in nitak lam-a liim om tawh kibang a, lopa bangin kei ka vulgawp hi.
Ahih hangin Topa aw, nang na kip ngitnget a, khang tawntungin nangmah hong kiphawkna a kip hi.
Nangmah tho-in Zion khua na hehpih ding hi; amah na angvan hun ding hi ta hi; a kiciangtansa hun hong tung khin hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasemte in tua khua suangtumte itin a leivuite nangawn pammaih sa uh hi.
Minamte in Topa hong zahtak-in, leitung kumpi khempeuh in nangma minthan’na hong zahtak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Zion khua lam ding a, ama minthan’na hong kilang ding hi;
amah in, mi cimawhte’ thungetna kin-in, amau’ thuumna simmawh lo ding hi.
A suak nai lo mite in Topa a phat theih nadingun, hong tung ding khang mite’ adingin hih thu kiciamteh hen:

Mihingte, kumpi gamte, Topa bia dingin a kikaikhop uh ciangin, mite in Zion khua sungah Topa ’ min leh, Jerusalem khua-ah amah phatna a pulak theih nadingun, thongkiate’ taunate za ding leh a si dinga kisehte a khahkhia dingin amah in a sangna ama siangtho mun panin hong ensukin, vantung panin Topa in leitung hong en hi.
Amah in, kei a khangtung kimlai ka thahatna hong suktat sak a, ka hunte hong khiapsak khin hi.
Keimah in, “Khang tawntungin a kip ka Pasian aw, kei hong khan’sih sak kei in!” ka ci hi.
Tanglai hunin nangmah in leitung bulpi na koih a, vantungte zong nangma khut tawh na bawlsa ahi hi.
Amaute sia ding a, ahih hangin nang na kip hi; amaute pen puan bangin paatkhia ding hi. Nangmah in amaute pen puan bangin na kheek a, amaute maimang uh hi;
ahih hangin nang na kibang ngitnget a, na nuntak kumte in mong nei lo hi.
Na nasemte’ tate, lungmuangin om ding uh a, amau suan-le-khakte nangma mai-ah kip ding uh hi.
